Brought to Glinda's tent, Mombi was compelled by threat of death to speak the truth, revealing that she had transformed Princess Ozma into Tip. Along the way, he irritated his companions with constant puns until warned by the Tin Woodman. Upon reaching the Emerald City, Queen Jinjur captured the group and threatened to turn the Woggle-Bug into goulash or soup, but they escaped to the roof and constructed the Gump to fly away. After crashing into a nest of Jackdaws—who are the natural enemies of his race—the Woggle-Bug was hidden under the Scarecrow's straw, swallowed a Wishing Pill to mend the Gump's wings, and escaped with the group to Glinda's palace. He accompanied Glinda's army to liberate the Emerald City, where Queen Ozma appointed him Public Educator and later built the College of Art and Athletic Perfection, making him its Dean and President. During a trial in the Emerald City, he served as Public Accuser against Dorothy's kitten Eureka. Later, he composed and read an 'Ode to Ozma' at her birthday celebration.

Because her uncle King Evoldo had sold the royal family to the Nome King, she took money from the treasury and was the nearest approach to a ruler Ev had. When Dorothy Gale visited her, Langwidere insisted on exchanging heads with Dorothy. Upon Dorothy's refusal, the Princess ordered her army to lock Dorothy in the North Tower. Soon after, Princess Ozma of Oz arrived with her party and forced Langwidere to release Dorothy. Langwidere declined to join the expedition to rescue the royal family from the Nome King because she disliked heat and wished to admire her heads. value: The Cowardly Lion met the Tin Woodman
unit: The Cowardly Lion first met Dorothy Gale, the Scarecrow, and the Tin Woodman when he bounded from a forest and attacked them, though he quickly confessed his cowardice and joined their journey to ask the Great Oz for courage. During their travel to the Emerald City, he carried his companions over deep chasms, faced the terrifying Kalidahs, and swam across a river to save their raft. While running through a field of deadly poppies, he fell asleep from the scent and was rescued by thousands of field mice organized by the Scarecrow and Tin Woodman. Upon reaching Oz, the Wizard demanded the death of the Wicked Witch of the West before granting his request. Sent to the Winkie Country, the Lion was captured by Winged Monkeys, imprisoned, and threatened with starvation by the Witch, but Dorothy secretly fed him at night until she melted the Witch. After returning to Oz and discovering the Wizard was a humbug, the Lion drank a potion provided by Oz, which he believed granted him true courage. He accompanied Dorothy to the Land of the South, along the way defeating a giant spider-monster and being chosen as King of the Forest by its animal inhabitants. Later, he joined Princess Ozma's expedition to the Land of Ev and the Nome King's underground kingdom, where he repeatedly braved the Iron Giant's pounding hammer to carry Ozma's army to safety. He subsequently became a faithful vassal and royal chariot-puller alongside his companion, the Hungry Tiger, serving Princess Ozma and guarding the Royal Palace of Oz.

value: A storm at sea occurred before they were cast ashore
unit: Billina was cast ashore with Dorothy Gale in a chicken coop after a storm at sea. Upon arriving on the beach of the Land of Ev, Dorothy renamed her Billina and discovered she could talk in fairy lands. Billina uncovered the golden key that unlocked Tiktok's storage room and accompanied Dorothy through Ev, advising her and warning her about Wheelers. When taken captive by Princess Langwidere, Billina was put into a chicken house, where she fought and conquered the local rooster before being freed by Ozma's party. During the expedition to rescue the royal family of Ev from the Nome King, Billina hid under the throne and overheard the King revealing that the enchanted royals were purple ornaments. She subsequently used this secret to disenchant the entire royal family of Ev, as well as Ozma and her followers. She also accidentally laid an egg in the throne room, discovering that eggs are deadly poison to Nomes, which allowed her group to force the Nome King's compliance. Following the adventure, Billina was rewarded with a jewel necklace by the new King of Ev and chose to settle permanently in the Land of Oz due to its superior bugs. She later hatched ten chicks in Oz, naming every single one of them 'Dorothy', and attended Princess Ozma's birthday celebration with her brood.
